Operator CPC training

Preparation for people working towards the transport-manager qualification.

In plain English

Operator CPC is the qualification associated with being a transport manager on a goods-vehicle operator licence. It is not Driver CPC, and it is not a driving entitlement.

Who it is for

People who need the transport-manager qualification, or who want to understand what it covers before they book. It is not periodic driver training.

What it covers

  • Preparation for the transport-manager exams, in the form the course actually covers
  • Not a Driver Qualification Card, and not a Category C or C+E licence

The examining body and the current exam format are set officially, so check the latest guidance. We explain what the preparation covers when you enquire.

Eligibility and prerequisites

A general guide. We check your own licence when you enquire.

  • No driving entitlement is assumed
  • The difference between Operator CPC and Driver CPC is explained before anyone books
  • We can talk through whether the qualification applies to your role

What the training includes

  • How Operator CPC differs from Driver CPC
  • What the study covers, in outline
  • Dates agreed with you when you enquire
  • Classroom preparation at our Bristol and Taunton bases

How the course works

  1. Enquire about Operator CPC

    Say that you mean the transport-manager qualification, not Driver CPC.

  2. Confirm the exams you are aiming for

    We check the current exam format against official guidance, so you know what you are preparing for.

  3. Study for the qualification

    Classroom preparation for the exams. We confirm the timetable when you enquire.

  4. Ask how the exam is booked

    We explain how the exams are booked when you enquire.

Training format

Classroom course at our Bristol and Taunton bases. We confirm dates when you enquire.

Why train here

  • Clear about each course

    We explain who a course is for, what it leads to and how it runs before you are asked to commit to anything.

  • Courses matched to the right base

    Each course page shows which of our bases run it, so you only see training you can actually take.

  • Practical and classroom routes

    Licence training is time in the vehicle. Driver CPC, ADR and Operator CPC are classroom courses, each with its own page.

  • A straightforward enquiry

    Tell us the course, your preferred base and how to reach you. An enquiry does not book a test or commit you to anything.

Questions about this course

Is Operator CPC the same as Driver CPC?

No. Operator CPC is the transport-manager qualification. Driver CPC is for professional drivers. They are separate courses.
